note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a Const 24(3), HON 3(12), 63, 64; A06b Const 24(3), HON 3(12), 63, 64; L05 Const 29(1), HON 65(1)): ordinary naturalisation after 3 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships (with major exceptions); a citizen keeps it on taking another (loss applies only to naturalised citizens, not modelled). Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Honduras, 2024
sources.said: Person has been resident in Honduras for a continuous period of 3 years. ... Renunciation of another citizenship (unless dual citizenship treaty applies). ... Person is a citizen by naturalisation and acquires citizenship of another country.
